# Kenta Young

> Software Engineer and Photographer based in SW Idaho. Over a decade of experience building web applications, Shopify storefronts, and polished user experiences.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kentayoung.dev/): About, skills, and contact information.
- [Work](https://kentayoung.dev/work): All case studies and other projects.
- [Needed case study](https://kentayoung.dev/work/needed): Custom subscription purchasing on Shopify and Recharge.
- [FabFitFun case study](https://kentayoung.dev/work/fabfitfun): Configurable page modules in React, TypeScript, and a headless CMS.
- [HU Kitchen case study](https://kentayoung.dev/work/hu-kitchen): Building a Shopify storefront, from product pages to cart upsells and accessibility fixes.
- [Photography](https://kentayoung.dev/photography): Landscape, nature, and travel photography.

## About

Kenta Young is a Software Engineer with a strong focus on Shopify development and frontend engineering. He spent nearly 4 years at [The Beyond Group](https://thebeyondgroup.com/), the last 1.5 years as a Senior Software Developer leading a small team. Notable clients include Needed, FabFitFun, Our Place, House of Spoils, HU Kitchen, Dagne Dover, Unhide, Auri Nutrition, Solawave, Cometeer, MUD\WTR, and Loyal.
